rangeUnordered: The end is before the start

errors.alreadyExists: This already exists. Please check the details.
errors.invalidState: Something changed in the meantime. Please reload the page.
errors.periodLocked: This date is in a closed month and locked.
errors.forbidden: You are not allowed to do this.
errors.notFound: Not found. The entry may have been removed in the meantime.
errors.validation: The details were not accepted. Please check the fields.
errors.reauthRequired: Please confirm your sign-in again to do this.

people.title: People
people.lead: Employees with personnel number, team, start date and leaving date. Contracts and leaving are on each person's page.
people.newHint: The first contract starts on the start date. Later changes are added as a new contract with its own valid-from date.
people.emptyHint: “Add person” creates the first person together with a contract.
people.name: Name
people.exitHint: No target time accrues after this day, the leave entitlement is prorated.
people.exitConfirmText: The last working day is {{date}}. The leaving date cannot be removed here afterwards.

contracts.title: Contracts
contracts.newHint: The minutes per weekday are copied from the working time model when saving. Later changes to the model leave this contract alone.
contracts.vacationDaysHint: Days with at most one decimal place, e.g. 30 or 27.5
contracts.basisDaysHint: Working days per week the leave entitlement refers to
contracts.capHint: Hours:minutes, empty means the company setting
contracts.deleteText: The contract has not started yet. Without it, the previous contract stays valid from that day on.

workModels.title: Working time models
workModels.lead: Target time per weekday. A contract copies the minutes when it is created, later changes to a model only affect new contracts.
workModels.formHint: Times as hours:minutes. An empty day is a day off.
workModels.name: Name

teams.title: Teams
teams.lead: The team lead decides on requests and corrections of their team. Who belongs to a team is set in the person's details.
teams.name: Team
teams.leadsHint: People with a user account can be chosen. Nobody decides on their own requests, HR takes those over.
teams.emptyHint: Without a team, requests only reach HR.

notices.title: Leave forfeiture notices
notices.lead: Remaining leave is only forfeited if the person was told about the entitlement and the deadline in time (BAG 2019). Every notice is stored with balance, deadline and channel.
notices.yearHint: The notice names the remaining leave from this year
notices.none: No notice for this year yet

flex.title: Flextime postings
flex.lead: Opening balance, manual postings and payouts per person. Caps are only posted by the month-end close.
flex.chooseHint: Balance, postings and monthly figures appear once a person is chosen.

capModes.forfeit_at_close: excess is forfeited at month-end close

flex.newHint: Every posting needs a reason and stays in the audit log. Mistakes are fixed with a counter posting.
flex.minutesHint: Hours:minutes, deductions with a minus, e.g. -8:00
flex.noMonths: No monthly figures for this year

findings.title: Findings under the ArbZG
findings.lead: Notices from checking against the ArbZG (Working Hours Act). Acknowledging records that a finding was seen and assessed, it stays in the audit log. Not legal advice.
findings.noteHint: What was behind it or what was agreed, e.g. an appointment at a client
findings.emptyHint: Another status or a longer period shows older findings.

text.ARBZG_3_OVER_8: {{minutes}} worked, more than 8 hours, allowed if balanced out within six months
text.ARBZG_3_OVER_10: {{minutes}} worked, more than the permitted 10 hours
text.ARBZG_5_REST_UNDER_11H: {{restMinutes}} rest period before work, 11 hours required

rules.title: Rule versions
rules.lead: The limits findings are checked against. A finding keeps the version it was made with.

months.title: Month-end close
months.lead: A closed month locks time entries, requests and contracts up to its last day. Months are closed in order and for the whole company.
months.nothingClosed: The month is closed, nothing is left open.

checklist.previous_month_open: The previous month is not closed yet
checklist.open_finding: Findings under the ArbZG not acknowledged

checklistHint.running_entry: The person has to clock out or request a correction.
checklistHint.pending_correction: The team lead or HR has to decide.
checklistHint.pending_absence: The team lead or HR has to decide.
checklistHint.open_finding: Findings can still be acknowledged after the close.

months.closeLead: Afterwards time entries, requests and contracts up to {{date}} are locked.
months.blocked: Can be closed once the blocking points are resolved.
months.notClosable: This month cannot be closed yet.
months.closeText: Time entries, requests and contracts up to and including {{date}} get locked. Where a flextime balance is above the cap, the excess is posted.
months.closeReopenHint: Only administration can reopen it, with a reason.
months.closeOrder: Months are closed in order, the oldest open month first.
months.reopenLead: Only the most recently closed month can be reopened. Time entries and requests can then be changed again.
months.reopenAdminOnly: Only administration can reopen a month.
months.reopenAudit: The reason is kept in the audit log.
months.reopenText: The month stays open for changes until it is closed again.
months.reopenOrder: Only the most recently closed month can be reopened.

exports.title: Exports
exports.lead: Timesheet per person and the monthly overview of everyone, as CSV for payroll or as a print view for PDF.
exports.timesheetLead: Every day of the month with time entries, breaks, target, worked time and absences.
exports.chooseEmployee: Choose a person for the timesheet.
exports.csvHint: CSV with a comma as the separator, UTF-8 with BOM. Excel opens the files without extra steps.
exports.notClosed: The month is still open. The figures can change until it is closed.

audit.title: Audit log
audit.lead: Every change to time entries, requests, contracts and master data with time, person, old and new value. Entries can neither be changed nor deleted.
audit.emptyHint: A longer period or another area shows more.

opening.none: No carry-over from a December close of the previous year
opening.carryover: Plus {{minutes}} carried over from last year's December close, without a posting of its own
